title: Board dimensions (40/30/26) hardcoded in both new tools instead of read from data/balance.json (ODN-5 single-source)
evidence:
tools/osm_extract.py:72-75:
# Board size (data/balance.json map.*): the camera fits this into 1280x720.
BOARD_W_TILES = 40
BOARD_H_TILES = 30
TILE_PX = 26

tools/render_dublin_preview.py:30:
TILE_PX = 26          # data/balance.json map.tile_px

data/balance.json (tail):
  "map": {
    "w_tiles": 40,
    "h_tiles": 30,
    "tile_px": 26
  }
detail: Three copies of the board contract exist (balance.json, two tools). Retuning map.* makes future re-bakes silently produce assets mis-fitted to the game board — exactly what ODN-5 forbids.
recommended_fix: Both tools read map.* from data/balance.json; render_dublin_preview.py consumes asset["board"]["tile_px"] (it already consumes w_tiles/h_tiles from the asset).

title: Asset stores projection scale but not the fit origin; render tool re-implements bake's centered-fit math to recover it
evidence:
tools/render_dublin_preview.py:180-190:
    # Tile coords for crop anchors (same math as osm_extract.bake).
    import pyproj
    tr = pyproj.Transformer.from_crs("WGS84", "EPSG:32629", always_xy=True)
    b = asset["board"]
    scale = b["scale_tiles_per_m"]
    ul = tr.transform(asset["extract"]["bbox"]["west"], asset["extract"]["bbox"]["north"])
    lr = tr.transform(asset["extract"]["bbox"]["east"], asset["extract"]["bbox"]["south"])
    cxm = (ul[0] + lr[0]) / 2.0
    cym = (ul[1] + lr[1]) / 2.0
    ox0 = cxm - (b["w_tiles"] / scale) / 2.0
    utm_top = cym + (b["h_tiles"] / scale) / 2.0

tools/osm_extract.py:364-368:
    cxm = (utm_x0 + utm_x1) / 2.0
    cym = (utm_y0 + utm_y1) / 2.0
    ox0 = cxm - (BOARD_W_TILES / scale) / 2.0
    #   board_y = (utm_top - y) * scale, utm_top = cym + (BOARD_H_TILES/scale)/2
    utm_top = cym + (BOARD_H_TILES / scale) / 2.0
detail: The board block's keys are w_tiles/h_tiles/tile_px/projection/scale_tiles_per_m/center_latlon — no origin. Every consumer needing lat/lon→tiles must replicate bake's letterbox math; a bake fit change silently desyncs previews.
recommended_fix: Bake the origin into the board block (e.g. "origin_utm": [ox0, utm_top]); render_dublin_preview.py consumes it directly, deleting its re-derivation.

title: All asset geometry is float tile units; the float→integer-tile seam for the future in-game consumer is declared nowhere
evidence:
tools/osm_extract.py:171,311-312:
QUANT = 0.02
...
def quant(v):
    return round(round(v / QUANT) * QUANT, 2)

data/maps/dublin.json spawn_candidates (read via python3 json.loads): first entries [[0.0, 3.82], [0.02, 3.8], [0.04, 3.78]] — all floats.

core/catalog.odin:6: "Sim-relevant values are integers only."
detail: Repo rule: catalog sim values are integer-only (ODN-10). If the follow-up feeds spawn_candidates into integer-tile terminal placement, the float→tile mapping is defined nowhere in the asset, rulings, or schema.
recommended_fix: Store centi-tile integers (value×100, lossless at QUANT=0.02) or declare the float→tile mapping in the asset's _comment/board block for the consumer.

title: 3.9 MB single-line asset is a ~365× outlier vs every existing data/*.json; the runtime load-path choice for the follow-up is recorded nowhere
evidence:
data/maps/dublin.json = 3,889,867 bytes, 224,646 spawn_candidates (all other data/*.json are 980–10,704 bytes).

app/render/palette.odin:176 (the #load-embed pattern; palette.json is 6,726 bytes):
DEFAULT_PALETTE_JSON :: #load("../../data/palette.json")

app/main.odin:1846 (the dev disk-read pattern):
	nt, e1 := os.read_entire_file_from_path("data/node_types.json", context.temp_allocator)
detail: The asset fits neither existing load path unchanged: #load-embedding 3.9 MB bloats every rebuild that touches it; fail-fast per-field parsing over 224,646 entries also needs a deliberate decision. Nothing records the intent.
recommended_fix: Record the intended runtime load path (disk read, likely pre-parsed/binary) in the asset _comment or field notes before the follow-up wires the asset in.
